description: Use when you need a wallet's token balances on several chains in one call: native coin plus USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC/cbBTC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Polygon. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /wallet/balance, $0.003 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One wallet across several chains. For one token on one chain use evm_erc20_balance; for the native coin on one chain use evm_native_balance; for many wallets use wallet_balance_batch. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.

address.description: 0x address or ENS name (lowercase a-z, 0-9, hyphen)

chains.description: comma list of ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon (default: all EVM chains for a 0x address)
